question: Pivoting is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pivoting is related to **Basketball**.
 
• Pivoting is when a player stands still and steps with one foot.
 
• The foot that stays on the ground is called the **pivot foot.**
